AnswersIn.title: AnswersIn
AnswersIn.description: {question_id: answer}. Blank is allowed and counts as "I don't know" (assess.md).

adjustment_message.title: Adjustment Message
adjustment_message.description: Required when assessed_level != claimed_level; else null

Band.title: Band
Band.description: Mastery bands (spec §4.9). Stored in concept_progress.band; set by pedagogy.band().

objective_level.title: Objective Level
objective_level.description: Bloom level of the mastery statement's verb

prereqs.title: Prereqs
prereqs.description: Ids of direct prerequisites in this map

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Every concept id once, each after its prereqs

sequence_rationale.title: Sequence Rationale
sequence_rationale.description: Why this order, written to the learner

ConceptMap.title: ConceptMap
ConceptMap.description:
Stored in courses.template_plan and plan_versions.plan. These graph rules hold for
every stored map, including after the learner cuts concepts (PC1.4).

CourseConfig.title: CourseConfig
CourseConfig.description: Stored in courses.config (JSONB). New knobs = new fields with defaults, no migration.

CourseIntake.title: CourseIntake
CourseIntake.description: The intake form (spec §4.1). Defaults live in CourseConfig/Mission and the form.

observation.title: Observation
observation.description: What the answer showed or failed to show

LessonOutput.title: LessonOutput
LessonOutput.description: Stored in lessons.content. Field order is the streaming order the learner sees.

note.title: Note
note.description: The underlying belief in one plain sentence

Misbelief.title: Misbelief
Misbelief.description:
A specific wrong belief (spec §4.6–4.7): what a distractor represents, or what the grader
found. Logged to `misconceptions` when a learner shows it.

Mission.title: Mission
Mission.description: Stored in courses.mission (JSONB): what the learner is really after (spec §4.1).

PlanDiff.title: PlanDiff
PlanDiff.description: Stored in plan_versions.diff: what changed against the previous version (spec §4.8).

ProbeQuestionView.title: ProbeQuestionView
ProbeQuestionView.description:
What the learner sees. `targets_concept` stays server-side: naming the concept being
checked is a hint (spec §4.2: no hints).

QuizResult.title: QuizResult
QuizResult.description: Stored in quiz_attempts.feedback, so the results page can be reloaded.

QuizView.title: QuizView
QuizView.description: The quiz without answer keys, misconception tags or the rubric: any of those is a hint.

Remedy.title: Remedy
Remedy.description: Set by code (never the model) on a remediation concept inserted by the adapt rules.

Rule.title: Rule
Rule.description:
Which rule fired after a graded attempt. Stored in plan_versions.rule when it changes the
plan (insert_remediation, offer_test_out once accepted).
